title: Central African Republic vs Benin: confirmed line-ups, 4 changes
text:
Central African Republic vs Benin: confirmed line-ups, 4 changes

 Central African Republic make four changes from their 4-1 defeat by Benin on 12 November. Benin name the same starting XI.
 Rieltony LOUBOKO · Author profile · 16/11/2026 15:53 UTC

 The match: Central African Republic vs Benin, 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers, Matchday 4 of the group stage, kick-off at 16:00 GMT
 Central African Republic: 4-1-4-1 formation, 4 changes from the previous match
 Benin: 4-2-3-1 formation, no changes from the previous match
 Central African Republic and Benin meet on Monday, 16 November 2026, at 16:00 GMT, on Matchday 4 of the group stage in the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers. Both coaches have named their starting XIs.
 For Central African Republic, Abdelaziz Kerkache goes with a 4-1-4-1 and makes four changes from the 4-1 defeat by Benin on 12 November: Séverin Tatolna, James Emmanuel Okeke, Edwin Quarshie and Moustapha Djimet come into the starting XI. Dominique Youfeigane starts in goal. Badara Diomandé and Geoffrey Kondogbia feature in a five-man midfield, with Goduine Koyalipou leading the line alone. Among the substitutes are Louis Didace Mafouta , Alladoum Kolimba and Sami wattel.
 Key figures
 4-1-4-1 Central African Republic formation 4-2-3-1 Benin formation Matchday 4 group stage matchday G. Rohr's Benin, by contrast, leave things unchanged. The XI is the same as on 12 November, in a 4-2-3-1. Marcel Dandjinou is in goal, Sessi D'Almeida and Imourane Hassane operate in midfield, and Aiyegun Tosin leads the attack on his own. Owolabi Allagbé Kassifa and Jodel Dossou are among the substitutes.
 Benin won 4-1 in the previous match between the two sides. Central African Republic return with four new faces in their starting XI against an unchanged Benin side.

 Substitutes: Louis Didace Mafouta, Alladoum Kolimba, Chris Mbai Assem, Delphin Mokonou, Ghislain Mounguide, Joël Jordan Ngoya, Salomon Sambia, Isaac Solet Bomawoko, Sami wattel, B. Bwire, B. Bwire, B. Bwire
